codesFaq.question: How do I redeem codes?
codesFaq.answer: Open the game, click the settings gear in the top-right, paste your code into the Redeem Code field, and confirm. Codes are case-sensitive.

codesFaq.question: Why do codes stop working?
codesFaq.answer: Codes expire on a schedule set by the developer (usually monthly or tied to update milestones), and some are one-per-account. This page is re-tested regularly.

codesFaq.question: How often are new codes released?
codesFaq.answer: New codes typically arrive with each major game update. Bookmark this page and check back after every patch.

codesFaq.question: Do codes expire?
codesFaq.answer: Yes — most codes have an expiry date, shown next to each code. Expired codes move to the expired table below.

items.question: What is Heartopia and what platforms is it available on?
items.answer: Heartopia is a cozy multiplayer life simulation game developed by XD Games. Players can build and decorate cottages, tend gardens, catch over 90+ species of fish, cook recipes, and socialize with neighbors across iOS, Android, and PC.

items.question: How often do developers release new Heartopia codes?
items.answer: XD Games releases new official benefit promo codes every Monday, along with milestone celebration codes during major version livestream previews and seasonal holiday events.

items.question: What time does the Heartopia server reset each day?
items.answer: Heartopia servers reset daily at 6:00 AM UTC. Merchant shop inventories, daily commissions, resource gathering nodes, and resident friendship quests refresh at this specific time.

items.question: What is the fastest way to earn gold coins early in Heartopia?
items.answer: The most profitable method is unlocking the Cooking Hobby at Dream Guide Level 5 with Chef Massimo. Cooking raw ingredients like truffles into Black Truffle Pies or berries into Jams multiplies crop resale value by 200% to 350% when sold to Albert Jr.
